database_snapshot_limit: each database has its own read transaction; not a joint production write freeze
table_hash_method: sort SHA256 digest bytes of each compact UTF8 JSON row; concatenate digest bytes; SHA256 result; bytes represented as binary_hex object

studio.scope: published and draft content/journal/product payload references; historical free-text metadata not covered

relations.join_contract: Studio owner_id and miniapp user_id equal generator users.openid, not its numeric id

critical_gaps: complete independently stored backup and restore
isolated full restore and final freeze rehearsal
